experiment: Canonical v1 explicit total-memory-utility linear router
utility: loss_disabled - loss_real from frozen canonical v1
objective: BCEWithLogits sign(utility), weighted by min(abs(utility),1); no class balancing
target_alignment: hidden state at position t predicts token t+1; final position excluded
features: canonical early-active, late pre-injection RMS-normalized IDX8 hidden state
trainable: late gate w and b only, 1025 parameters
frozen: base backbone, PLE, reader, gammas, beta, alpha_early, alpha2_raw; no LoRA
selection: last epoch only; calibration monitored, never select on frozen evaluation
data: first 512 blocks of the frozen v2 training stream, not held-out diagnostics
split: blocks 0:384 train,384:512 calibration; existing stream disjoint from evaluation
